what_is_missing: Delivered biomass prices (halm, traeflis, traepiller) for 2019-2024
why_it_matters: SOEB25 Tabel 2 and Tabel 5 both start at 2025, so a 2019-2026 backtest has no fuel price for 6 of 8 years. Fuel price is the first-order driver of whether a biomass CHP runs at all.
where_to_look: Option 1: stitch the near-year values from older SOEB editions (2018, 2019, 2021, 2023), each of which prices its own first years off contemporaneous forwards, then put them on one basis using price_index_2025base in soeb25_params.csv. Option 2: Energistyrelsen 'Energipriser og afgifter' quarterly observed statistics.
do_not_use: SOEB25's 2025 figure as a proxy for earlier years. Tabel 5 Note 3 states its forwards were drawn January 2025, so even the 2025 cell is a forward view, not an outturn.
blocks: Backtest years 2019-2024, all biomass CHP units
